g.text: 2020 threshold graph | 179 countries | 797 edges | 12 isolates (no matrix)
Colored cells = internal adjacency; gray lines = individual external edges attached to country rows/columns.
Alphabetical ISO-code order within each matrix is supplied in community_country_order.csv.
Static overview; groups use weighted greedy modularity. Links describe profile similarity.
